plan.notes: Source: Blinn College District official HVAC AAS award page (blinn.edu/academics/degree-certificates/hvac-aas.html), the current award plan referenced by the 2024-2025 Catalog Vol. 85. Semester sequence and credit hours transcribed exactly: 16/14/15/15 = 60 credits. The paired 'or'-linked XXXX rows are single 3-credit core slots (the only reading under which the semesters sum to their declared totals). The award page explicitly states the course order is a suggestion. No courses invented.
